requirements.quote: The enclosure color must be black.
The power supply module (PCB) must be of surface mount technology and be able to fit in the dimensions of the Device bottom handle part
requirements.text: The PCB must be surface mount and fit the device bottom handle.

requirements.quote: Power Supply Module PCB is of Surface mount with minimum of double-layer PCB type.
requirements.text: The PCB must be surface mount and at least double-layer.
The PCB dimensions must be 33mm x 33mm x 5mm.

requirements.quote: PCB Mounting: Corner mounted with (6mm x 3mm) head screws measured 28mm from the centre of the screw holes.
requirements.text: The PCB must be corner mounted with specified screws and measurements.

requirements.quote: PCB Complexity: Solder Masking, minimum of double-layer and silk screening
requirements.text: The PCB must have solder masking, at least double-layer, and silk screening.

requirements.quote: Quality: IPC Class II specification. Supplier must provide a manufacturing report or certificate for quality assurance
requirements.text: The PCB must meet IPC Class II and include a quality assurance report.

requirements.quote: micro-USB connector positioned to fit as described in the Step file (body fingerprint scanner Bottom Step file).
requirements.text: The micro-USB connector must fit as per the Step file.
